stem:
Light of a single frequency is incident on a diffraction grating. Seven bright spots are observed on
a screen.
Which change will result in an increase in the number of bright spots observed?

options.A: Increase the distance between the grating and the screen.
options.B: Increase the frequency of the incident light.
options.C: Increase the intensity of the incident light.
options.D: Increase the number of lines per metre in the grating.
